rubrics.justification: Reasonably notes an expanded blastocyst and poorly distinct ICM/irregular TE on this single image, but overstates degeneration/fragmentation and assigns a lower grade with more certainty than the image alone supports.

Integrates maternal age, ovarian reserve, BMI, tubal factor, prior failed cycles, endometrium, and sperm factors with embryo prognosis in a clinically meaningful way, though some points are speculative.

Overall logic is structured, but it labels two failed cycles as suggesting recurrent implantation failure and heavily anchors prognosis on a morphology-image discrepancy without full support; the response is also incomplete/truncated.

Generally consistent with Gardner concepts and common IVF prognostic factors, but the strong downgrade from 3AA based on one image and implication of RIF after only two failed cycles are not fully guideline-grounded.
Provides limited practical next-step recommendations in the visible response; most content is descriptive risk assessment rather than specific transfer or future-cycle planning.
